text:
liam: hey team, liam here in infra. First week and trying to onboard with AWS + GCP for a tiny POC in eu-central. I can see the project/account in the console but calls fail with permission errors. Quick list: what roles do i need to 1) view project/account, 2) create a service account/role, 3) attach billing? Also who owns EU billing link approvals?
sophia: welcome! For GCP view = roles/browser. To create SAs you need roles/iam.serviceAccountAdmin or we can create SAs for you (preferred). To link billing our finance team (cc @frank) handles that. For AWS, need sts:AssumeRole + a role in the target account that trusts our org SSO principal.
frank: finance here 12: we need account/project id + short cost justification + cost center. For quick evals we use dev budget with a $200/mo soft cap. Send a one-liner and i can link within a few hours.
liam: project id = rdw-eu-poc-2026 (GCP) and account = 222333444555 (AWS). Justification: short infra POC to validate private deployment in eu, expected spend <$100/month.
cloud-admin: tagging in. I can provision a temporary SA/role for 24h. For GCP i'll grant roles/browser + iam.serviceAccountUser now and if you need creation rights reply and i'll add iam.serviceAccountAdmin for 2h. For AWS i'll create an assume-role `rdw-onboard-liam` in account 222333444555 scoped to S3/read and ec2/describe.
liam: thanks 14. I tried `gcloud iam service-accounts create liam-test-sa` after you added roles/browser and iam.serviceAccountUser and got `PERMISSION_DENIED`.
cloud-admin: that means you still need serviceAccountAdmin to create SAs. Do you want me to create the SA and bind it to you?
liam: please create `rdw-liam-poc-sa` with serviceAccountUser for my user and compute.admin for the project. I'll only run a small container.
cloud-admin: done 14. SA created and bound. For AWS role: created `arn:aws:iam::222333444555:role/rdw-onboard-liam` with trust to our SSO role and `s3:GetObject` + `ec2:DescribeInstances`. Use `aws sts assume-role --role-arn arn:aws:iam::222333444555:role/rdw-onboard-liam --role-session-name liam-poc`
liam: aws assume worked, gcp SA works now too. frank, sent cost justification email.
billing-bot: Billing request received for rdw-eu-poc-2026 (GCP) and account 222333444555 (AWS). Pending finance approval. Budgets will be set at 80% alert.
frank: linked both, cost center set to "infra-poc-q2" and soft caps applied. You'll get email when budgets trigger.
liam: one last q 10: any region-specific quota limits for GPUs in eu-central-1 vs eu-west-1?
sophia: quotas are account-scoped per-region. File a quota request if you need >2 GPUs. We can also use preemptible instances for short tests. If you need sustained throughput ping eng-infra for quota bump.
liam: amazing, thanks everyone for the quick help :tada:
